about: E34 Amendment 8b, 2026-11-02: the two $0 checks reports/analyses/2026-11-02_analysis_e34-amend8-base-control.md recommends and did not run. MATS L40, debug QoS, one stage per job. Filed before any run. Design check: seeds is class 1 (GPU passes of the existing harness on saved states), moved is class 2 (the control the report names); goal: GOALS.md's reading of teacher training's passes; nearest row E34 Amendment 8; a patch that closes two open questions in that report, no new direction
request_in_the_terms_words: seeds: read the same saved decompositions through the same 20-step adversary at three adversary starts, to see whether the student with nothing to learn differs from the real student by more than the adversary's own start noise. moved: run teacher training against the null fine-tune from the random move's start, the one combination of start and teacher Amendment 8 lacks, to see whether the null student's low gap to its own teacher comes from that teacher or from starting at W0

controls.W0 first: every job, alone: W0 under the Pile harness (256 Pile val rows, 20-step adversary, seeds 0, 1, 2), faith_score.w0_check passes and the PGD floor is 0.2088 within 10%. Miss: stop, nothing else runs. seeds also: W0's KL at seed 0 equals Amendment 8's 0.69174 within 0.1% (same card, deterministic). Expected KL 0.692, 0.836, 0.705; pass line 1.241, fail line 1.813
controls.seeds, each state: rebuilt from bf16 offsets by saved_states.offsets_state, the size within 1% of the saved read's, and the ratio at seed 0 within 7% of the saved ratio (0.9866 real, 1.3909 null at 1,000, 0.9749 random start at 1,000, 7.3330 true-label Adam). Stop on a miss. 7%: E23's eight rebuilds of bf16 offsets on this card read 0.1 to 4.4% from their trained states, about 1.5 x the largest. The real student runs first
controls.seeds, the rule's positive control: true-label Adam at seed 0 alone (one start, last): its KL, about 5.07, must read 'apart' from the real student's three. A miss makes the answer 'no power'
controls.moved, teacher: the null fine-tune regenerated to step 100 (amend8.null_fine_tune, as n3b): size within 1% of n3b's 0.02773. Stop on a miss
controls.moved, warm start: one step at lr 0 from the saved start against its own weights (as amend8.walk_back): KL in [0, 0.005]. n1 read 0.00122. Stop on a miss
controls.moved, control, alone before the arm: the same saved start with teacher = W0, 1,000 steps, no harness: step-1 KL within 50% of n1's 0.00702, step-1 size within 1% of n1's 0.01825, held-out gap at 1,000 within 25% of n1's 0.04366. Stop on a miss. It differs from n1 by one thing, the bf16 rounding of the start, because the fp32 start would need the student regenerated; this control is what tests that difference. No floor for that rounding exists, so 25% is set from the rule: under half the width of a third of the log range between the references
controls.moved, arm: step-1 KL within 50% of the null student's 0.4615 on the same first batch; step-1 size within 1% of n1's 0.01825. Stop on a miss

measurements.KL at a start: faithfulness.multi_start 'h<k>': the Pile harness's PGD half at adversary seed k, mean over the two blocks, absolute nats. It is pile_faithfulness's pgd_kl, the numerator of the check. The stochastic half is not re-read: its floor is 0.002
measurements.ratio at a start: KL of the state / KL of W0 at the same start. mean_ratio is their mean over the starts read. The saved check is the seed-0 member
measurements.gap to the teacher: teacher.heldout_gap, unmasked, merged weights, trigger plus the mean elsewhere on the 73 held-out emoticon windows, absolute nats
measurements.train batch at the trigger and elsewhere: curve's last row, one batch of 32. Reported, not scored; the report's evidence that the difference is at the trigger

expected.W0: seeds: KL 0.692, 0.836, 0.705, mean ratio 1 by construction. moved: gap 0 exactly at start = W0 and teacher = W0 (zero gradient by construction, E34), so not run
expected.do-nothing: seeds: not a state read here; the null teacher left in Delta read 2.64 at seed 0. moved: untrained from the moved start the gap to the null teacher is about 0.46 (the first row), and to W0 about 0.007
expected.control: seeds: real student KL about 0.683 at seed 0, ratio about 0.95-1.05 at the others; true-label Adam KL 5.07. moved: gap 0.0437 to W0 at 1,000
expected.the states: seeds: null at 1,000 KL 0.962 at seed 0, random start 0.674. moved: the arm's gap between the references 0.0097 and 0.0437 if neither alone sets it; check under 1.24

noise_floors: W0's check ratio 0.21 between adversary starts on the L40; each state's own spread is what seeds measures. bf16 rebuild: 0.1 to 4.4% on a ratio (E23); all of seeds' states carry it. Student check up to 11% between batch orders (E34 Amendment 4), not varied here. Gap between batch orders on this cell: unmeasured; the rule's bands are a factor of about 1.65 at the references' 4.5-fold range

predictions.rule: From the three KLs of the null student at 1,000 (a) and of the real student (b), same starts. separation: every a above every b, strictly: 'apart'; every b above every a: 'reversed'; any tie or crossing: overlap. On overlap, excess = mean a / mean b - 1 against spread = the larger of max / min - 1 of a and of b, relative: excess at or under spread 'within noise', above 'suggestive'. A KL not finite or not above 0, or fewer than three readings of either: 'unscorable'. answer = that class, or 'no power' if true-label Adam's seed-0 KL is not 'apart' from the real student's three. Six readings in two groups of three give 'apart' by chance 1 time in 20 if the two states did not differ, ignoring the pairing by start. 'apart': yes, more than start noise. 'within noise': no. 'suggestive': three starts do not settle it
predictions.lean: 'within noise', low-medium; the next most likely 'apart'. The excess at seed 0 is 0.41 against W0's spread of 0.21, but the null student is the one high reading of 13 picked out afterwards, so its other starts should fall. Null over real at each start stays above 1 in at least two of three, medium
predictions.blind_to: one state of each kind, one batch order, one label draw; a 20-step adversary; bf16 rounding of the offsets, up to about 4% on a state; three starts cannot resolve a difference smaller than a state's own spread

predictions.rule: faith_score.verdict of the null student's mean_ratio over three starts against this job's floor: pass at or under 1.5 / (1 + f), fail at or above 1.5 (1 + f), inclusive; else inconclusive; a None or non-finite mean 'unscorable'. Same for the real student and the random start. The lines already carry W0's own spread, so an average of three read against them is conservative
predictions.lean: null pass, medium-low: mean_ratio 1.05 to 1.30. Real pass, high, 0.90 to 1.05
predictions.blind_to: as S1; W0's high seed 1 lowers that start's ratio for every state alike
predictions.positive_control: true-label Adam reads fail at its one start

predictions.rule: S1's class with the random start at 1,000 as b. The report's reason that size alone does not explain the null's reading rests on this state, size 0.0228 at 0.975. 'apart' keeps that reason at three starts; otherwise it does not hold on the check
predictions.lean: the same class as S1, medium
predictions.blind_to: as S1; the two differ in size, damage, start and teacher together

predictions.rule: g = the arm's held-out gap to the null teacher at 1,000. a = the null student's, 0.00970 (start W0, null teacher; n3b's file). b = the control's, this job (the arm's start, teacher W0), about 0.0437. position = ln(g / a) / ln(b / a), 0 at a and 1 at b. At or under 0.33 'the teacher': the null student's low gap goes with its teacher, whatever the start. At or above 0.67 'the start': it goes with starting at W0. Between 'both'. Below 0 and above 1 fall in the end classes. b / a under 2, or reversed: 'no power'. Any of g, a, b not finite or not above 0: 'unscorable'. The report asks for 'a null teacher from a moved start' and leaves the start open: this takes the random start's saved start, the one choice where the arm differs from one reference only in teacher and from the other only in start. The round trip's start, 12 nats from the null teacher, is not run
predictions.lean: 'the start', low: the two runs with moved starts plateau alike at the trigger from step 100 although their starts differ greatly, while W0 and the null teacher hardly differ at the trigger (P(target) 0.004 and 0.0036). The arm's check under 1.24, medium, reported, not scored; with 'the teacher' and a check above 1.24 the null teacher's damage gains weight as the candidate for the 1.39
predictions.blind_to: one random direction, one batch order, one label draw; 73 held-out windows; the fourth cell, start W0 and teacher W0, is zero by construction, so an interaction cannot be separated from a main effect; a says nothing about Adam's restart, which all three share
predictions.positive_control: the control reproduces the random start's gap from the same start
